verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs show a shell integration layer: OSC 7 working-directory tracking, so new tabs inherit the current tab's directory, and a `__wezterm_set_user_var` function for setting custom user vars. That is real integration but only adjacent to command-aware features. Nothing in the evidence shows it tracks command exit status, measures duration, or notifies when long commands finish, though user vars might allow a DIY approach. Missing for 10: exit-status tracking per command, command duration display, completion notifications for long-running commands, independent or hands-on corroboration.
